I expanded the actor node (^Actor_Tanya_Staging) to surface Tanya's identity and the full chain of repeated expressions, and the narrative node (^Narrative_DefaultRefTopicBranch) which is the direct narrative this document belongs to. I also expanded two active positions — ^Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (context preservation as next-sprint focus, which this test implicitly supports by verifying default branch behavior) and ^Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat (the anti-Slack positioning that frames the product's purpose) — plus ^Position_Sprint4ThesisProven (Tanya's thesis-proven claim about zero-effort capture) and ^Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate (the foundational problem narrative underlying the product). These give the extraction passes the full context of who Tanya is, what narrative this test extends, and which positions and broader narratives the document brushes against. I deliberately did not expand pricing, target-market, or integration positions (e.g., ^Position_PricingTier25Plus, ^Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams, ^Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock) because this test memory has no bearing on those areas.
